rule.statement: The commencement of prescriptive possession can coincide with the commencement of possession itself if the possessor enters the land in a capacity inconsistent with the owner’s title.
rule.supporting_quote: The commencement of prescriptive possession can coincide with the commencement of possession itself if the possessor enters the land in a capacity inconsistent with the owner’s title. If not, the possessor shall signify the change in the character of possession by an overt act or a series of acts indicative of a challenge to the owner’s title.
